title: 第一卷 第19章 铁犀团凤无极第一卷 第20章 人人都该惜命
lines: 半上午的时候，凤州城数里外，远远的掀起一大片飞扬的尘土，宛如腾升的黄雾。
闷雷一般的声响，震动着大地，也震颤着城门守卫的心脏。
“是……是凤家的铁犀团！”
“快去禀报城主！”
以往的经验告诉这些守卫，凤家铁犀团入城，必是要生大事！
轰轰轰——
黄尘飞扬间，十三人骑着十三头巨大的兽影，冲到城门楼下，方才停了下来。
强劲的气浪裹胁着一股难闻的气味，冲击向城门守卫，迫得这些城门守卫连连跌退，脸色发白间，有些想吐。
这些巨兽，一个个壮如成年巨象，头顶一大一小两根黑色兽角，一身褐色的皮毛，犹如铁皮一般，看上去便是力量惊人，防御极强。
这是凤家豢养的铁犀，虽是一种低阶灵兽，但对于大多武者来说，已是不可匹敌的存在。
眼前这十三头，只是铁犀团的一部分而已。
“凤家铁犀团入城，还不给老子让开！”
为首的铁犀背上，络腮中年怒目一瞪，满脸凶戾，根本没将这些守卫放在眼里。
“是是，凤二爷请入城。”守卫们连忙散开一些，低头哈腰的堆着笑容。
对于眼前这位凤家二爷，这些守卫都不陌生，自然不敢挡道。
“哼！”凤无极冷哼一声，“入城！”
轰轰轰——
十三头铁犀，排成一条长龙队伍，冲进凤州城内。
沿途中，人马惊散，却是尽皆敢怒不敢言。
很快，凤无极等人在百宝楼前停下。
一个老者身影，慌忙从街角奔出，神色惶恐的跪到凤无极跟前。
“二……二爷，百宝楼已经被搬空了！里面什么都没了！”跪地的老者，带着哭腔道。
凤无极眼眸一眯，俯视着老者问道：“张隆运，昨日百宝楼出事时，你在何处？”
这张隆运，乃是凤家的一名客卿，有着宗师境巅峰的修为，也是凤无极派来坐镇百宝楼，保护姬夫人的强者。
可昨日姬夫人被杀时，张隆运却没在百宝楼。
跪地的张隆运神色一颤，忙道：“回二爷，老朽是听闻月牙山上出现了一株灵参，想着找来献给二爷，所以昨日一早就去了月牙山，不曾想，百宝楼却是出了事。是老朽该死，没能保护好姬夫人！”
凤无极冷冷一笑：“是吗？可有人告诉我，你前夜去了醉花楼，昨日一早，只怕还在女人的肚皮上宿醉未醒吧？”
张隆运瞳孔惊张，连忙道：“二爷，老朽不敢欺瞒，前夜老朽确实是去了醉花楼，但真的天一亮，就出城去了月牙山啊。老朽追随二爷十多年了，老朽对二爷的忠心，日月可鉴啊！”
凤无极哼声道：“如果不是看你还有点用的份上，老子现在就一掌拍碎了你的狗头！”
“那小子现在在何处，你可知道？”
张隆运连忙道：“知道知道，老朽回来后，就一直暗中盯着那小子，此刻他应该还在秦府之中。”
“带路！”
“好，老朽这就给二爷带路，同时，老朽还有一些消息，要向二爷禀报。”
“有屁就放！”
铁犀团朝着秦家过去的路上，张隆运将昨夜发生的事情，告诉了凤无极。
content_en:
In the middle of the morning, a few miles away from Fengzhou City, a large cloud of flying dust was raised in the distance, like rising yellow mist.
The thunderous sound shook the earth and shook the hearts of the city gate guards.
"Yes...it's the Iron Rhinoceros Group of the Feng family!"
"Hurry and report to the city lord!"
Past experience tells these guards that if the Feng family's Iron Rhinoceros regiment enters the city, something big will happen!
Boom boom boom——
While the yellow dust was flying, thirteen people rode thirteen huge beast figures and rushed to the city gate downstairs before stopping.
The strong air waves were accompanied by an unpleasant smell and hit the city gate guards, forcing them to fall back one after another, their faces turned white, and they felt like vomiting.
Each of these giant beasts is as strong as an adult giant elephant. They have two black horns on their heads, one large and one small. They are covered in brown fur that is like iron skin. They look amazingly powerful and have extremely strong defense.
This is the iron rhinoceros raised by the Feng family. Although it is a low-level spiritual beast, it is already invincible to most warriors.
The thirteen heads in front of me are just part of the iron rhinoceros group.
"The Feng Family Iron Rhinoceros Group has entered the city, and you still won't get out of my way!"
On the back of the leader Tie Xi, the middle-aged man with a cheekbones glared angrily, his face full of ferocity, and he did not take these guards seriously at all.
"Yes, Master Feng, please come into the city." The guards quickly dispersed, bowing their heads and smiling.
These guards were all familiar with the second master of the Feng family in front of them, so naturally they did not dare to block his way.
"Hmph!" Feng Wuji snorted coldly, "Enter the city!"
Boom boom boom——
Thirteen iron rhinoceros formed a long queue and rushed into Fengzhou City.
Along the way, the people and horses scattered in shock, but they all dared to be angry and dare not speak.
Soon, Feng Wuji and others stopped in front of Baibao Tower.
An old man hurriedly ran out from the corner of the street and knelt down in front of Feng Wuji with a fearful expression.
"Second...Second Master, the Baobao Building has been evacuated! There is nothing inside!" The old man kneeling on the ground said with a cry.
Feng Wuji narrowed his eyes, looked down at the old man and asked, "Zhang Longyun, where were you when the accident happened in Baibao Tower yesterday?"
Zhang Longyun was a guest of the Feng family, with a cultivation level at the peak of the Grand Master realm. He was also a strong man sent by Feng Wuji to guard the Baibao Tower and protect Mrs. Ji.
But when Mrs. Ji was killed yesterday, Zhang Longyun was not in Baibao Tower.
Zhang Longyun, who was kneeling on the ground, looked trembling, and said hurriedly: "Back to the second master, I heard that a spiritual ginseng appeared on Crescent Mountain, and I wanted to find it and present it to the second master, so I went to the Crescent Mountain early yesterday morning. I never thought that something happened to Baibao Tower. It's the old man who deserves to die because he failed to protect Mrs. Ji!"
Feng Wuji smiled coldly: "Really? But someone told me that you went to Zuihua House the night before, and you were probably still hungover on the woman's belly early yesterday morning, right?"
Zhang Longyun's pupils were frightened and he said quickly: "Second Master, I don't dare to lie. I did go to Zuihua Tower the night before, but at dawn, I left the city and went to Crescent Mountain. I have been following Second Master for more than ten years, and I can learn from the sun and the moon about my loyalty to Second Master!"
Feng Wuji snorted: "If it weren't for the fact that you are still useful, I would smash your dog's head with one palm right now!"
"Do you know where that kid is now?"
Zhang Longyun said quickly: "I know, I have been secretly watching that kid since I came back. He should still be in the Qin Mansion at this moment."
"Lead the way!"
"Okay, I will lead the way for the second master. At the same time, I have some news that I want to report to the second master."
"If you fart, let it go!"
On the way the Tie Xi Tuan headed towards the Qin family, Zhang Longyun told Feng Wuji what happened last night.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 19 Iron Rhinoceros Tuan Feng Wuji Volume 1 Chapter 20 Everyone should cherish their lives
